f3_program: collection("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "daily_buyer_count", "grocery_store", source("There are 40 more buyers in the grocery store today than yesterday"))
offset(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "today"), at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "yesterday"), 40, "count", source("40 more buyers in the grocery store today than yesterday"))

fraction_of(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "yesterday"), at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "day_before"), 1, 2, source("half the number of buyers yesterday as there were the day before"))
observe(at("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "day_before"), 50, "count", source("the day before had 50 buyers"))
partition("grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "grocery_store.three_day_buyers.count", source("Nobody visited the store on more than one day"))
query("sum", "grocery_store.daily_buyer_counts", "three_days")
collection("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "daily_new_email_count", "business_executive.inbox", source("four day vacation"))
observe(at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_1"), 16, "count", source("The first day he is gone, he receives 16 new emails"))

fraction_of(at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_2"), at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_1"), 1, 2, source("On each of the following days, he receives half as many new emails as he received on the prior day"))

fraction_of(at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_3"), at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_2"), 1, 2, source("On each of the following days, he receives half as many new emails as he received on the prior day"))

fraction_of(at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_4"), at("business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "day_3"), 1, 2, source("On each of the following days, he receives half as many new emails as he received on the prior day"))
query("sum", "business_executive.vacation.daily_new_email_counts", "four_day_vacation")

offset(at("bert.barrel.sale.value", "current"), at("bert.barrel.warehouse_purchase.value", "current"), 10, "dollar", source("He buys his products in a warehouse and sells them for $10 more in his shop"))
percent_of(at("bert.barrel.sale.tax", "current"), at("bert.barrel.sale.value", "current"), 10, source("From each sale, he has to pay 10% of the value in tax"))
observe(at("bert.barrel.sale.value", "current"), 90, "dollar", source("a barrel for $90"))
query("value", at("bert.barrel_sale.money_made", "current"))
assumptions: The general product markup and per-sale tax assertions apply to the barrel sale.

f3_program: observe(at("miriam.pushups.count", "monday"), 5, "count", source("On Monday she does 5 push-ups"))
observe(at("miriam.pushups.count", "tuesday"), 7, "count", source("On Tuesday she does 7 push-ups"))
multiple(at("miriam.pushups.count", "wednesday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "tuesday"), 2, source("On Wednesday she does twice as many push-ups as the day before"))

sum_relation("miriam.pushups.total_before_thursday", at("miriam.pushups.count", "monday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "tuesday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "wednesday"), source("total pushups she already did that week"))
fraction_of(at("miriam.pushups.count", "thursday"), "miriam.pushups.total_before_thursday", 1, 2, source("On Thursday she does half the number of total pushups she already did that week"))

sum_relation("miriam.pushups.total_previous_four_days", at("miriam.pushups.count", "monday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "tuesday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "wednesday"), at("miriam.pushups.count", "thursday"), source("the total number she did over the previous four days"))
same(at("miriam.pushups.count", "friday"), "miriam.pushups.total_previous_four_days", source("on Friday she does as many pushups as the total number she did over the previous four days"))
query("value", at("miriam.pushups.count", "friday"))
observe(at("jim.biweekly_paycheck.money", "initial"), 1120, "dollar", source("Jim’s bi-weekly gross pay is $1120"))
percent_of("jim.biweekly_paycheck.retirement_contribution.amount", at("jim.biweekly_paycheck.money", "initial"), 25, source("25% of his paycheck go into his retirement account"))

transfer("retirement_contribution", "jim", at("jim.biweekly_paycheck.money", "current"), at("jim.retirement_account.money", "current"), "jim.biweekly_paycheck.retirement_contribution.amount", source("He automatically has 25% of his paycheck go into his retirement account"))
remove("tax_withholding", "they", at("jim.biweekly_paycheck.money", "current"), 100, source("They also take $100.00 out of each paycheck for taxes"))
query("value", at("jim.biweekly_paycheck.money", "current"))
assumptions: The stated gross paycheck is the reference amount for the 25% retirement contribution.
